UDALL PAPERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF ARIZONA
Udall Undergraduate Scholarship
Important Dates

October 9
The 2027 online application is available. Faculty representatives may register students for their campus nomination process at http://facultyreps.udall.gov.

March 3, 2027
Faculty reps must register students for the online application by this date.

March 4, 2027
Applications must be submitted through the online system by 11:59 p.m. MST (Note: institutional deadlines may be earlier. Please check with your faculty representative.)

April 21
Faculty reps can check their students’ application status at http://facultyreps.udall.gov and may notify their students of the results.

April 22
The Udall Foundation will send email notifications to all applicants.

April 29
Deadline for Udall Foundation receipt of Scholar Award Reply form

May 12
Udall Scholars announced on www.udall.gov

Required Statements
